summary: Ascensia Diabetes Care led a $36 million Series B round in London-based glucose sensor maker Sava Technologies, the startup said Friday. The companies also struck a strategic partnership that gives Ascensia exclusive commercialization and distribution rights, starting in Europe. Based in Basel, Switzerland, Ascensia is a subsidiary of Tokyo’s PHC Holdings. Sava is developing a wearable glucose sensor that could expand to other biomarkers in the future. Sava hopes for the device to provide more options for people who use continuous glucose monitors in a market currently dominated by Abbott and Dexcom.
